title: Passing a cocycle computation to all homology classes
statement: Let K and B be cochain complexes of abelian groups [def-sp-abelian], t:K→B, and p a nonnegative degree. Let e:E→Hᵖ(K) be injective, e′:E′→Hᵖ(B) and g:E→E′ arbitrary functions. Suppose repr assigns an element of E to each cycle z in K, with e(repr(z))=πK(z) and e′(g(repr(z)))=πB(cyclesMap(t)(z)). Then Hᵖ(t)(e(x))=e′(g(x)) for every x:E.

source.place: Mathlib HomologicalComplex.homologyπ_naturality and AddCommGrpCat.epi_iff_surjective; elementary passage from cycle representatives to homology.

proof.text: Lift e(x) through the surjective homology projection πK. The first representative identity and injectivity of e identify x with repr(z). Substitute this equality, then apply naturality of the homology projection and the second representative identity.

theorem homology_transfer_of_cycle_representatives
    {E E' : Type*} (K B : CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat.{u} ℕ) (t : K ⟶ B) (p : ℕ)
    (e : E → K.homology p) (he : Function.Injective e)
    (e' : E' → B.homology p) (g : E → E')
    (repr : K.cycles p → E)
    (hsource : ∀ z, e (repr z) = K.homologyπ p z)
    (htarget : ∀ z, e' (g (repr z)) =
      B.homologyπ p (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap t p z)) (x : E) :
    ((HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (.up ℕ) p).map t) (e x) =
      e' (g x)
